definition: אֶ֫מֶשׁ adverb yesterday (etymology dubious; MV after Fl De on Job 30:3 compare Sta § 256 c derive from √ משׁה = Arabic , whence , evening ; see also in Thes , & compare Assyrian mušu , night COT Gloss , Ethiopic but also Arabic = Assyrian amšatu , yesterday ) = last night Gen 19:34 ; Gen 31:29 ; Gen 31:42 ( אָ֑מֶשׁ ); = recently 2Kgs 9:26 . — Job 30:3 שׁוֺאָה ׳ א is difficult & uncertain Thes MV and others darkness, gloom of wasteness, so RV , but dubious, compare Di ; G. Hoffm . reads ׳ אֵם שׁ = the mother of (all) the ruined ( said of the desert). אֱמֶת אֲמִתַּי see אמן . אַמְתַּ֫חַת see מתח .

Hoffm. reads ׳אֵם שׁ = the mother of (all) the ruined ( said of the desert).

אֱמֶת אֲמִתַּי see אמן.
